title: Running Commentary on Torah 33 — Mi Ha'Ish He'Chafetz Chayim
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 33 — מי האיש החפץ חיים
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **Opening pasuk**: **"Mi ha'ish he'chafetz chayim, oheiv yamim li'r'os tov"** (Tehillim 34:13). 'Who is the man who desires life, loves days to see good?' Decoded at end: **chafetz=lev; chayim=da'as; oheiv yamim=drawing love into the middos/days; li'r'os tov=seeing the or ha'ganuz**.

intermediate.en: **"Mi ha'ish he'chafetz chayim, oheiv yamim li'r'os tov"** (Teh 34:13): **chafetz**=lev; **chayim**=da'as; **oheiv yamim**=love into middos; **li'r'os tov**=or ha'ganuz.
intermediate.he: **"מי האיש החפץ חיים, אוהב ימים לראות טוב"** (תה' לד, יג): **חפץ**=לב; **חיים**=דעת; **אוהב ימים**=אהבה למידות; **לראות טוב**=אור הגנוז.

beginner.en: **"א. Klal: must **seek shalom** — shalom bein Yisrael, and **shalom b'middosav**. No machlokes in his middos/events: **bein b'tivo, bein b'ako** — always find Hashem in him. **'Ba'Hashem ahalel davar, b'Elokim ahalel davar'** (Tehillim 56:11). How find Hashem in both states? Via **Torah called shalom** — **'v'chol nesivoseha shalom'** (Mishlei 3:17; Zohar Korach)."**

intermediate.en: **α. Klal: seek shalom** bein Yisrael + **shalom b'middosav** (Teh 56:11 "ba'Hashem/b'Elokim ahalel"). Via Torah=shalom (Mishlei 3:17 "v'chol nesivoseha shalom," Zohar Korach).
intermediate.he: **α. כלל: בקשת שלום** בין ישראל + **שלום במידותיו** (תה' נו, יא "בה'/באלוקים אהלל"). דרך תורה=שלום (מש' ג, יז "וכל נתיבותיה שלום", זוה"ק קרח).

scholarly.he: סעיף א. תה' נו, יא; מש' ג, יז.

beginner.en: **"ב. Know: **'melo kol ha'aretz k'vodo'** (Yeshayahu 6:3); **'leis asar panui minei'** (Tikkun 57); **'hu m'malei kol almin v'sovev kol almin'** (Ra'ya Mehemna Pinchas 225a). Even one engaged in **masa u'matan with akum** cannot excuse himself that avodas Hashem is impossible due to **aviyus u'gashmiyus** that constantly falls upon him — Chazal already revealed: **in every gashmi thing, and in every lashon of akum, one can serve Hashem**."**

intermediate.en: **β. Hashem fills all** (Yesh 6:3; Tik 57; RM Pin 225a). **Even MU"M with akum** — no excuse; every gashmi thing + every akum-lashon: can serve Hashem.
intermediate.he: **ב. ה' ממלא כל** (יש' ו, ג; תיקון נז; רע"מ פינ' רכה.). **אף מו"מ עם אומות** — אין תירוץ; בכל גשמי + בכל לשון אומות: אפשר לעבוד את ה'.

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. יש' ו, ג; תיקון נז; רע"מ פינ' רכה.

beginner.en: **"ג. Two kinds of **yamim**: **y'mei tov + y'mei ra** — **'b'yom tovah heyeh b'tov, u'v'yom ra'ah r'eh'** (Kohelet 7:14). One must look carefully — even in a bad day, he will find a **y'mei tov = Torah**. Days = middos (**'u'midas yamai,'** Tehillim 39:5). Middos = Torah — for all Torah speaks of **ahavah, yirah, and other middos**. With Torah HKBH created the world."**

intermediate.en: **γ. 2 yamim: tov+ra** (Koh 7:14). Look carefully: find **y'mei tov=Torah**. Yamim=middos (Teh 39:5 "u'midas yamai"); Torah=middos (ahavah/yirah).
intermediate.he: **ג. ב' ימים: טוב+רע** (קה' ז, יד). עיון: מצוא **ימי טוב=תורה**. ימים=מידות (תה' לט, ה); תורה=מידות (אהבה/יראה).

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. קה' ז, יד; תה' לט, ה.

beginner.en: **"ד. Torah/middos/yamim = **ahavas Hashem dwells in them**. Zohar (Balak 191b; Bereshis 46a) on **'yomam y'tzaveh Hashem chasdo'** (Tehillim 42:9) — **chesed=ahavah** (**'ahavas olam ahavticha... al kein m'shachticha chesed,'** Yirmiyahu 31:2) — **'yoma d'azal im kulhu yomin'** = the middos. Middos = tzimtzumim to His Elokus so we can grasp Him via His middos (Zohar Pinchas)."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Torah/middos/yamim=ahavah dwells**. Zohar Balak 191b; Ber 46a on "yomam y'tzaveh chasdo" (Teh 42:9); chesed=ahavah ("ahavas olam," Yir 31:2). Middos=tzimtzumim to Elokus.
intermediate.he: **ד. תורה/מידות/ימים=אהבה שוכנת**. זוה"ק בלק קצא:; בר' מו. על "יומם יצווה חסדו" (תה' מב, ט); חסד=אהבה ("אהבת עולם", יר' לא, ב). מידות=צמצומים לאלוקות.

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. זוה"ק בלק קצא:; בר' מו; תה' מב, ט; יר' לא, ב.

beginner.en: **"ה. 2 kinds of ahavah: (1) **ahavah she'b'yamim** = yoma d'azal im kulhu yomin — in each middah is Hashem's love with Israel = **b'po'al**; (2) **ahavah she'b'ko'ach** = love between Israel and Hashem **before creation** (when Israel were in His **da'as u'mo'ach**). Like a father's love for a son — graspable; but **hachlatas ha'ahavah** (the decision/resolution of love) that the father decided before the birth — not graspable by the son at all. This is **ahavah she'b'ko'ach = ahavah she'b'da'as = ahavah above yamim/middos**."**

intermediate.en: **ε. 2 ahavahs**: (1) **b'yamim** (b'po'al; in each middah); (2) **b'ko'ach** (before creation; Israel in His da'as/mo'ach). Like father's **hachlatas ahavah** pre-birth — ungraspable. **Ahavah she'b'da'as** above yamim.
intermediate.he: **ה. ב' אהבות**: (1) **בימים** (בפועל; בכל מידה); (2) **בכוח** (לפני הבריאה; ישראל בדעתו/מוחו). כהחלטת אהבה של אב טרם הלידה — לא נתפסת. **אהבה שבדעת** מעל ימים.

beginner.en: **"ו. Even within middos themselves, each relative to the level below = **bechina of da'as to it**. Chazal (Midrash Rabbah Shir; Tosfos Yevamos 103b on **'ha'm'salem'**): **'mah she'asasah chochmah ateret l'rosha, asasah anavah akeiv l'soleisa'**. Thus the lowest level of olam Yetzirah = **bechina of da'as for olam Asiyah** below. Therefore one's **ahavah with Hashem in his middos+time** is **ahavah she'b'da'as of the world above him**."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Each middah relative to below=da'as**. Midrash Rabbah Shir / Tos Yev 103b: "mah she'asasah chochmah ateret l'rosha, asasah anavah akeiv l'soleisa." Bottom of Yetzirah=da'as of Asiyah. Ahavah b'middos+zman=ahavah b'da'as of upper world.
intermediate.he: **ו. כל מידה יחסית לתחתון=דעת**. מד"ר שה"ש / תוס' יב' קג: "מה שעשתה חכמה עטרה לראשה, עשתה ענווה עקב לסוליתא". תחתית יצירה=דעת של עשייה. אהבה במידות=אהבה בדעת של עולם עליון.

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. מד"ר שה"ש; תוס' יב' קג:.

beginner.en: **"Chazal (Moed Katan 17a on **'ki sif'sei kohen yishm'ru da'as'** (Mal'achi 2:7)): 'if the rav is **domeh l'malach Hashem Tzva'os** — **kofeh es yitzro** — then Torah is sought from his mouth. **Zohar: 'Barchu Hashem malachav giborei ko'ach'** — **'ilein inun d'misgabrin al yitzrayhon'**. Via **kofeh es yitzro**, **osiyos ha'Torah bolt'in u'mits'tarfin** — **bechina of na'aseh v'nishma** (builds+hears the osiyos)."**

intermediate.en: MK 17 / Mal 2:7: rav domeh l'malach Tzva'os=**kofeh yitzro**. Zohar "malachav giborei ko'ach"=mis'gabrim al yitzram. Kofeh yitzro → **osiyos bolt'in u'mits'tarfin**=na'aseh v'nishma.
intermediate.he: מו"ק יז / מל' ב, ז: רבי דומה למלאך צבאות=**כופה יצרו**. זוה"ק "מלאכיו גיבורי כוח"=מתגברים על יצרם. כופה יצרו → **אותיות בולטות ומצטרפות**=נעשה ונשמע.

beginner.en: **"ז. Every person can taste the **ohr ahavah she'b'da'as** per his bechina, **even now within the yamim** — by **tying his lev to his da'as**. Every Jew knows in general that there is **Elokim** — but resha'im are in the **power of the lev** (Bereshis Rabbah Noach 34). Middos+yamim are included in lev (Zohar Terumah 162b; Sanhedrin 106b: **'Rachmana liba ba'i'**); and **'u'vilvad she'yechavein es libo la'shamayim'** (Berachos 5b)."**

intermediate.en: **η. Taste ohr ahavah she'b'da'as** per bechina, **now within yamim** — by **tying lev to da'as**. Resha'im=power of lev (BR Noach 34). Middos/yamim in lev (Zohar Terumah 162b; San 106b **"Rachmana liba ba'i"**; Ber 5b).
intermediate.he: **ז. לטעום אור אהבה שבדעת** לפי בחינה, **עכשיו בימים** — ע"י **קישור לב לדעת**. רשעים=ברשות הלב (ב"ר נח לד). מידות/ימים בלב (זוה"ק תרומה קסב:; סנ' קו: **"רחמנא ליבא בעי"**; בר' ה:).

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. ב"ר נח לד; זוה"ק תרומה קסב:; סנ' קו:; בר' ה:.

beginner.en: **"**Peirush the pasuk**: **'Mi ha'ish he'chafetz chayim'** — **chafetz=lev** (chafetz is in lev); **chayim=da'as** (**'mekor chayim sechel be'alav,'** Mishlei 16:22). **Tying lev to da'as** = **libo bi'r'shuso** = kofeh yitzro. Then: **'oheiv yamim'** — draws love from **da'as into yamim/middos**. **'Li'r'os tov'** — sees the **ohr ki tov v'ganuz** — the **Torah ha'genuzah and the tzaddikim ha'genuzim**."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: **chafetz**=lev; **chayim**=da'as (Mishlei 16:22); tying lev→da'as=libo bi'rshuso/kofeh yitzro → **oheiv yamim** (love→middos) → **li'r'os tov**=**ohr ki tov ha'ganuz**/Torah+tzaddikim ha'genuzim.
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: **חפץ**=לב; **חיים**=דעת (מש' טז, כב); קשירת לב→דעת=ליבו ברשותו/כופה יצרו → **אוהב ימים** (אהבה→מידות) → **לראות טוב**=**אור כי טוב הגנוז**/תורה+צדיקים הגנוזים.

beginner.en: **R"N editorial**: **"I heard in his name that he said this Torah contains all the **kavanos of lulav**. I didn't merit to hear the explanation, but I researched and found a little: the ikkar kavanos of lulav is to **draw all chasadim down to the chazeh, to illuminate Malchus**. The **na'anu'im** are made to draw illumination **from shoresh ha'chasadim b'da'as** to the chasadim spreading through the body, adding great light from their source in da'as. See Pri Etz Chayim Sha'ar ha'Lulav. Also explained there: **lulav=da'as**..."**

intermediate.en: R"N: Torah holds **all kavanos of lulav**. Ikkar: draw chasadim from **shoresh b'da'as** → chasadim spreading in guf → Malchus. Na'anu'im=drawing from da'as. **Lulav=da'as** (PEC Sha'ar ha'Lulav).
intermediate.he: ר"נ: התורה מכילה **כל כוונות לולב**. עיקר: המשכת חסדים מ**שורש בדעת** → חסדים בגוף → מלכות. נענועים=המשכה מדעת. **לולב=דעת** (פע"ח שער הלולב).
